title: AffineSpectrumComparisonCancellation
statement: For affine schemes X,X′ and g′:X′→X, assume the derived categories and composition comparison of lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition. Write U_X=L(X.isoSpec.inv)*, V_X=L(X.toSpecΓ)*, A_g′ for the forward spectrum pullback comparison, D_g′ for the inverse spectrum comparison of def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates, and u_X:V_X U_X→Id for the inverse unit of the explicitly constructed equivalence in def-pc-affine-spectrum-direct-image-coordinates. For every K, A_g′ at U_X K, followed by V_X′ applied to D_g′(K), followed by u_X′ at Lg′*K, equals Lg′* applied to u_X(K). This is a single-morphism identity, with no direct-image functor, adjunction, square, or mate.

theorem affineSpectrum_comparison_cancellation
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X']
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (affineSpectrumForwardPullbackIso g').hom.app ((derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv).obj K) ≫
      (derivedPullback X'.toSpecΓ).map
        ((affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso g').hom.app K) ≫
      affineSpectrumUnitInv X' ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
    (derivedPullback g').map
      (affineSpectrumUnitInv X K)
